newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Malaysia's Mahathir in Zimbabwe for solar summit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mahathir in Zimbabwe for solar summit.

text.p: Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad arrived in Harare on Friday to attend a two-day international solar summit that begins on Monday.

Mahathir joins scores of delegates, mostly ministers and energy officials, who have been flying into Harare since Thursday for the conference that organisers say has attracted 5,000 delegates from 100 countries, including 25 world leaders.

The Malaysian leader is one 20 world leaders who serves on a commission launched in 1995 and headed by Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe to push research into solar power and other renewable sources of energy onto the world agenda.
